headline: Seven release, mobile, security, and public-truth upgrades shipped; the exact candidate is verified on canonical staging and production remains safely held by the real-provider Obelisk gate.

items.title: One fail-closed production path
items.insight: Local and CI Worker deploys now consume the same promotion ceremony, while promoted callers require fresh proof for every edge route they invoke.

items.title: Mobile findings became a release gate
items.insight: The runtime matrix passed 235/235 with zero P0/P1 and 63/63 changed visual states were manually reviewed across all themes.

items.title: Push storage is bounded and validated
items.insight: Origin, endpoint, key, quota, dedupe, quarantine, and fan-out contracts now constrain unauthenticated subscription storage.

items.title: Agent discovery matches crawler policy
items.insight: Training opt-out remains explicit while search and user retrieval can reach the public corpus; every named robots group is checked.

items.title: The Desk no longer calls an overdue edition daily
items.insight: Cadence derives from edition evidence and an overdue recovery packet is review-held rather than auto-published.

items.title: All sourced facts are agent-verifiable
items.insight: The claims stream now contains stable receipts for all 21 sourced facts inside a 37-row ledger.

items.title: Unknown evidence can no longer render green
items.insight: Tests, SIL, session, and CI states project from authoritative receipts without legacy aliases or unknown-as-green schedules.

followUps: Complete the Obelisk staging registration and real-provider journey, then require an 8/8 ceremony.
Rebind canonical staging to the exact commit selected for production promotion.
After promotion, force a deploy-currency probe and ordinary Doctor=0 or roll back.
blockers: Production promotion is held for real-provider-e2e-pending; the ceremony is 7/8.
The immutable GitHub Pages rollback-origin migration remains founder-scoped under D-S303.
